name: AMPscript Add
description: Computes the sum of two numeric values. Covers which argument types are accepted and which abort the page.

name: AMPscript AddObjectArrayItem
description: Appends an item — scalar or nested handle — to an array-valued property of a CreateObject handle.

name: AMPscript AttributeValue
description: Reads an attribute of the current message or page context by name. System attributes resolve there, the name is matched without regard to case, and an unknown name gives an empty value instead of failing.

name: AMPscript AuthenticatedEmployeeID
description: Returns the numeric employee ID of the Marketing Cloud user tied to the current context. A public, anonymous request still gets a non-empty ID back, so a non-empty result proves nothing about who is visiting.

name: AMPscript AuthenticatedEmployeeNotificationAddress
description: Returns the notification email address of the Marketing Cloud user tied to the current context. A public, anonymous request gets a real mailbox address back, and it is not the same string as the similarly email-shaped username.

name: AMPscript AuthenticatedEmployeeUserName
description: Returns the login username of the Marketing Cloud user tied to the current context. A public, anonymous request still gets a non-empty, email-shaped username back, so a non-empty result proves nothing about who is visiting.

name: AMPscript AuthenticatedEnterpriseID
description: Returns the enterprise ID (EID) of the Marketing Cloud account tied to the current context. A public, anonymous request gets the account's parent MID back even when the page itself runs on a child business unit.

name: AMPscript AuthenticatedMemberID
description: Returns the member ID (MID) of the business unit the code runs on. A public, anonymous request gets the child business unit's own MID back, while AuthenticatedEnterpriseID in the same render returns the parent's.

name: AMPscript AuthenticatedMemberName
description: Returns the display name of the business unit the code runs on. A public, anonymous request gets the business unit's UI display name back, which is neither a person nor the name your tooling configuration uses.

name: AMPscript BarcodeURL
description: Builds a URL that renders a barcode image from its inputs.

name: AMPscript Base64Decode
description: Decodes a Base64-encoded string. Malformed input aborts the whole page with HTTP 422 rather than returning an empty value.

name: AMPscript Base64Encode
description: Encodes a value as a Base64 string. The bytes encoded are the UTF-8 form of the input. The encoding argument accepts far more names than any source lists.

name: AMPscript BeginImpressionRegion
description: Marks the start of an impression tracking region. The region name must be a literal, and a variable argument aborts the page.

name: AMPscript BuildOptionList
description: Builds an HTML <option> list from literal value/text pairs. Covers exactly which pair is marked selected and what a non-matching default does.

name: AMPscript BuildRowsetFromJSON
description: Parses a JSON string and returns a rowset. Covers the third argument, which works the opposite way round from the documented syntax.

name: AMPscript BuildRowSetFromString
description: Splits a delimited string into a single-column rowset. Covers the unnamed column and the empty separator that splits nothing.

name: AMPscript BuildRowSetFromXML
description: Parses an XML string using an XPath expression and returns a rowset. Covers the third argument, which works the opposite way round from the documented syntax.

name: AMPscript Char
description: Returns the character for a numeric character code. Notes that the code domain is not capped at 255.

name: AMPscript ClaimRow
description: Claims the next unclaimed row of a data extension for a caller and returns the whole row, flipping its claim flag and recording the claimant.

name: AMPscript ClaimRowValue
description: Claims the next unclaimed row of a data extension for a caller and returns a single column value, falling back to a supplied default when no unclaimed rows remain.

name: AMPscript CloudPagesURL
description: Builds the published URL of a CloudPages landing page. Extra arguments must come in pairs, and a page ID that matches no page aborts the request instead of returning an empty string.

name: AMPscript Concat
description: Join values into a string with AMPscript Concat. Includes syntax, examples, and runtime-tested behavior for single arguments and boolean values.

name: AMPscript ContentArea
description: Inserts a Classic content area by its numeric ID. Covers the no-match default path and that default content is emitted literally. Classic content is retired; prefer ContentBlockByID.

name: AMPscript ContentAreaByName
description: Inserts a Classic content area by its folder path and name. Covers the no-match default path and that default content is emitted literally. Classic content is retired; prefer ContentBlockByName.

name: AMPscript ContentBlockByID
description: Retrieves and renders a Content Builder content block by its numeric ID. Covers the missing-block default path and that default content is emitted literally.

name: AMPscript ContentBlockByKey
description: Retrieves and renders a Content Builder content block by its customer key. Covers the missing-block default path and that default content is emitted literally.

name: AMPscript ContentBlockByName
description: Retrieves and renders a Content Builder content block by its full Name/path. Covers the missing-block default path and that default content is emitted literally.

name: AMPscript ContentImageByID
description: Returns an HTML img tag for a Content Builder image asset by its numeric ID. Covers the fallback-image path and that a missing image with no fallback aborts the page.

name: AMPscript ContentImageByKey
description: Returns an HTML img tag for a Content Builder image asset by its customer key. Covers the fallback-image path and that a missing image with no fallback aborts the page.

name: AMPscript CreateObject
description: Instantiates a named SOAP API object and returns a handle for SetObjectProperty, AddObjectArrayItem and the Invoke* executors.

name: AMPscript CreateSalesforceObject
description: Creates a new record in a connected Salesforce Sales or Service Cloud object via Marketing Cloud Connect and returns the 18-character ID of the created record. Notes that a successful create returns a real Salesforce ID and a fault aborts the page instead of returning an error value.

name: AMPscript DataExtensionRowCount
description: Returns the total number of rows in a data extension.

name: AMPscript DateAdd
description: Adds a whole number of intervals to a date. Notes that any unit outside the documented five destroys the page rather than returning a value.

name: AMPscript DateDiff
description: Returns the difference between two dates in the requested unit. Notes that it counts unit boundaries rather than elapsed time, so one minute either side of midnight is a whole day apart.

name: AMPscript DateParse
description: Parses a date string into a date value. Notes that a day-first date is silently read month-first while an unreadable one takes the whole page down.

name: AMPscript DatePart
description: Extracts a specific component from a date value. Notes that the hour comes back on a 12-hour clock with nothing to tell 7 AM from 7 PM.

name: AMPscript DecryptSymmetric
description: Decrypts a Base64 ciphertext produced by EncryptSymmetric. Covers which cipher names work and why an arity mistake cannot be hidden behind a condition.

name: AMPscript DeleteData
description: Deletes matching rows from a data extension and returns the number of rows deleted. Covers the return value and what a no-match returns.

name: AMPscript DeleteDE
description: Deletes matching rows from a data extension and returns an empty string. The email-context twin of DeleteData.

name: AMPscript Differs from Official Docs (Engagement)
description: AMPscript functions whose real behaviour on Marketing Cloud Engagement contradicts the official Salesforce documentation — wrong return types, wrong argument rules, undocumented behaviour. Every entry reflects how the engine actually behaves on Marketing Cloud Engagement.

name: AMPscript Differs from Official Docs (Next)
description: AMPscript functions whose real behaviour on Marketing Cloud Next contradicts the official Salesforce documentation — wrong return types, wrong argument rules, undocumented behaviour, and divergence from the same function on Engagement.

name: AMPscript Divide
description: Divides the first number by the second. Covers the undocumented zero-divisor result, which renders an infinity symbol instead of failing.

name: AMPscript Domain
description: Returns everything after the first at sign of an email address. Covers multi-level domains, which come back whole rather than reduced, and the original casing, which is preserved.

name: AMPscript Empty
description: Tests whether a value is missing or blank. Covers which inputs count as empty, and the exact literals True and False that the function renders.

name: AMPscript EncryptSymmetric
description: Encrypts a value with symmetric key encryption and returns Base64. Notes that the ciphertext is deterministic, so equal plaintexts are linkable.

name: AMPscript EndImpressionRegion
description: Marks the end of an impression tracking region. The optional argument accepts boolean, string, and number truthy values to close all open regions.

name: AMPscript ExecuteFilter
description: Executes a data-extension-based data filter and returns the matching rows as an unordered rowset. Covers what an empty filter returns and its case-insensitive matching.

name: AMPscript ExecuteFilterOrderedRows
description: Executes a data-extension-based data filter and returns the matching rows sorted by a column and capped to a row count.

name: AMPscript Field
description: Reads a named column from a rowset row. Notes that a missing column aborts the page unless the third argument is passed.

name: AMPscript Format
description: Formats a number, a date or a string with a .NET pattern. Notes that the documented data-format value Number aborts the page, and that this function and FormatDate disagree on the same date.

name: AMPscript FormatCurrency
description: Formats a number as a currency amount for a locale. Notes that the locale, not the function, decides the symbol position, the separators and even the number of decimal places.

name: AMPscript FormatDate
description: Formats a date according to a date pattern, a time pattern and a locale. Notes that mm in the date pattern renders the month, not the minutes.

name: AMPscript FormatNumber
description: Formats a number with a .NET numeric pattern, optionally for a locale. Covers half-up rounding, case-insensitive pattern letters, and the fact that an unrecognised pattern is echoed back instead of failing.

name: AMPscript Function Reference
description: Per-function AMPscript reference pages for Marketing Cloud Engagement, covering each function's signature, argument handling and edge cases.

name: AMPscript Function Reference (Next)
description: The subset of AMPscript that Marketing Cloud Next supports — searchable and filterable, with the Core API version each function became available in and its Handlebars equivalent.

name: AMPscript GetJWT
description: Generates a JSON Web Token signed with an inline secret. Notes that the algorithm name is matched case-insensitively and the payload is never validated as JSON.

name: AMPscript GetJWTByKeyName
description: Generates a JSON Web Token signed with a named Key Management key. Notes that the RSA algorithms really do sign with an uploaded asymmetric key, verifiable off-platform against its public key.

name: AMPscript GetSocialPublishURL
description: Returns HTML for sharing a content region on a supported social network via Social Forward. Notes that it yields a bare Publish.aspx URL and aborts the page on an empty content region.

name: AMPscript GetSocialPublishURLByName
description: Returns HTML for sharing a content region on a supported social network identified by name via Social Forward. Notes that it yields a bare Publish.aspx URL and aborts the page on an empty region or an unknown network name.

name: AMPscript GUID
description: Generates a new globally unique identifier. The result is 36 lowercase characters, hyphenated, no braces, and a different value on every call within the same render.

name: AMPscript Guide: Syntax, Examples & Functions
description: Learn AMPscript for Marketing Cloud Engagement with a beginner path, function examples, Data Extension lookup guidance, date formatting, and tracked email links.

name: AMPscript HTTPGet
description: Performs an HTTP GET request and returns the response body. Covers the status output variable that reports 0 on success and -2 on a failed request.

name: AMPscript HTTPPost
description: Performs an HTTP POST request and returns the HTTP status code. Covers the fourth argument that receives the response body rather than the status the docs describe.

name: AMPscript HTTPPost2
description: Performs an HTTP POST and returns the HTTP status code, exposing the response body and headers. Covers the response argument that holds the body while a separate rowset argument holds the headers.

name: AMPscript HTTPPostWithRetry
description: Posts content to a URL with automatic retry logic and returns the HTTP status code. Covers the responseStatus argument that holds the response body rather than the status the docs describe.

name: AMPscript HTTPRequestHeader
description: Returns the value of a specified HTTP request header from the inbound request. Notes that custom headers are returned even though the docs restrict it to standard headers.

name: AMPscript IIf
description: Picks one of two values from a boolean expression. Covers the undocumented fact that only the selected branch is evaluated, and that a plain string condition always picks the false branch.

name: AMPscript IndexOf
description: Returns the 1-based position of a substring, matching case-insensitively. Covers an undocumented third argument that selects which occurrence to locate.

name: AMPscript InsertData
description: Inserts a new row into a data extension using ordered column/value pairs and returns the number of rows inserted. Covers the return value and the read-back.

name: AMPscript InsertDE
description: Inserts a new row into a data extension using ordered column/value pairs and returns an empty string. The email-context twin of InsertData.

name: AMPscript InvokeCreate
description: Runs the SOAP API Create on a CreateObject-built handle and returns the OverallStatus.

name: AMPscript InvokeDelete
description: Runs the SOAP API Delete on a CreateObject-built handle and returns the OverallStatus.

name: AMPscript InvokeExecute
description: Runs the SOAP API Execute verb on an ExecuteRequest and returns a rowset of results.

name: AMPscript InvokePerform
description: Runs the SOAP API Perform verb on a definition object and returns the OverallStatus.

name: AMPscript InvokeRetrieve
description: Runs the SOAP API Retrieve on a RetrieveRequest and returns a rowset.

name: AMPscript InvokeUpdate
description: Runs the SOAP API Update on a CreateObject-built handle and returns the OverallStatus.

name: AMPscript IsCHTMLBrowser
description: Tests a user agent string for a compact HTML feature-phone browser. Covers the true path, which two feature-phone agent families still produce, while the empty string aborts the page.

name: AMPscript IsEmailAddress
description: Checks a value against email address syntax only. Covers a domain without a top-level domain, which the official reference documents as valid and the engine rejects.

name: AMPscript IsNull
description: Tests a value for a genuine null. It returns False for every input a page variable can hold, including the unset variable the official example says returns true.

name: AMPscript IsNullDefault
description: Returns a value, or a fallback when it is null. The fallback is never reached: every empty-ish input returns the empty string instead.

name: AMPscript IsPhoneNumber
description: Checks a value against the North American Numbering Plan. Covers Canadian and Caribbean numbers, which pass despite the function's reputation for being US-only.

name: AMPscript Length
description: Measures the size of a string. Covers the counting unit, which is UTF-16 code units rather than user-visible characters.

name: AMPscript LocalDateToSystemDate
description: Converts a date in the account's configured time zone to the Marketing Cloud system date. Notes that a date with no time part lands on the previous day.

name: AMPscript LongSFID
description: Converts a 15-character case-sensitive Salesforce ID to the 18-character case-insensitive version. Notes that a non-15-character input is passed straight through unchanged instead of being validated.

name: AMPscript Lookup
description: Use AMPscript Lookup to read a field from a matching data extension row. Includes syntax, multiple search criteria, examples, and no-match behavior.

name: AMPscript LookupOrderedRows
description: Returns a sorted, row-limited rowset of matching rows from a data extension. Covers the sort direction and the row limit.

name: AMPscript LookupOrderedRowsCS
description: Returns a sorted, row-limited rowset of matching rows using a case-sensitive comparison. Covers the difference from the case-insensitive LookupOrderedRows.

name: AMPscript LookupRows
description: Use AMPscript LookupRows to retrieve matching data extension rows as a rowset. Includes syntax, search criteria, examples, and empty-result handling.

name: AMPscript LookupRowsCS
description: Returns every matching row of a data extension using a case-sensitive comparison. Covers the difference from the case-insensitive LookupRows.

name: AMPscript Lowercase
description: Converts a value to lower case. Covers the culture-invariant casing that maps the dotted capital I to a plain ASCII i.

name: AMPscript MD5
description: Returns the MD5 hash of the input value. Covers that the bytes hashed are the UTF-8 encoding of the input, and that the encoding argument accepts far more names than either reference lists.

name: AMPscript MicrositeURL
description: Builds a Classic Content microsite URL. Covers that the page reference and any extra name-value pairs are folded into one encrypted token, and every call produces a different token.

name: AMPscript Mod
description: Returns the remainder after dividing the first number by the second. Covers the sign rule and the NaN result for a zero divisor.

name: AMPscript Multiply
description: Computes the product of two numeric values. Covers which argument types are accepted and which abort the page.

name: AMPscript Now
description: Returns the current system date and time in Central Standard Time. Covers that every call in one render returns the same frozen instant.

name: AMPscript Output
description: Writes the result of a nested function call into the rendered content. Covers a string literal argument, which renders nothing at all rather than the error the official reference promises.

name: AMPscript OutputLine
description: Writes the result of a nested function call into the rendered content, followed by a line break. Covers the exact two bytes it appends, which are a carriage return and line feed rather than an HTML break.

name: AMPscript ProperCase
description: Converts a value to proper (title) case. Covers that every letter after the first of a word is forced to lower case.

name: AMPscript QueryParameter
description: Returns the value of a URL query string parameter from the current page request. Covers that it is indistinguishable from RequestParameter on a GET.

name: AMPscript RaiseError
description: Raises a runtime error, optionally skipping the current subscriber or returning an API error. Covers that outside a send it is not a graceful abort: the message never reaches the caller and the response is indistinguishable from any other failure.

name: AMPscript Random
description: Returns a random whole number between two inclusive bounds. Covers the decimal bounds that the official docs allow but the runtime rejects.

name: AMPscript Redirect
description: Ends the request with an HTTP redirect to the supplied address. Covers that it is a real 302 with the value passed straight into the Location header, and nothing like the similarly named RedirectTo.

name: AMPscript RedirectTo
description: Use AMPscript RedirectTo for dynamic URLs in tracked email links. Includes syntax, examples, and how it differs from an HTTP redirect.

name: AMPscript RegExMatch
description: Returns the first occurrence of a regular expression match in a string, selected by capture group. Covers the case-sensitive matching that sets it apart from every other String function.

name: AMPscript Replace
description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring with a new value. Covers matching that ignores case and a single-pass scan that never revisits text it just inserted.

name: AMPscript ReplaceList
description: Replaces several search values with one common replacement value. Covers the sequential passes that let a later search value rewrite what an earlier one inserted.

name: AMPscript RequestParameter
description: Returns the value of a form post or query string parameter from the current request. Covers that names ignore case, values arrive decoded and unescaped, and a parameter supplied twice comes back comma-joined.

name: AMPscript RetrieveSalesforceJobSources
description: Returns the source records (SourceID, SourceType, IsInclusionSource) that made up the audience of a Salesforce-triggered send, matched by its numeric job ID, as a rowset. Covers that a job ID with no matching sources returns a clean empty rowset rather than an error.

name: AMPscript RetrieveSalesforceObjects
description: Retrieves records from a connected Salesforce Sales or Service Cloud object via Marketing Cloud Connect and returns them as a rowset. Covers that an unknown object name aborts the page and an empty match returns a clean empty rowset.

name: AMPscript Row
description: Returns a single row from a rowset by its 1-based index. Covers that index 0 aborts the page.

name: AMPscript RowCount
description: Returns the number of rows in a rowset. Covers that it returns zero for an empty rowset and never aborts.

name: AMPscript SetObjectProperty
description: Sets a scalar (or nested-handle) property on a CreateObject handle.

name: AMPscript SHA1
description: Returns the SHA-1 hash of the input value. Covers that the bytes hashed are the UTF-8 encoding of the input, and that an unrecognised encoding name aborts the page.

name: AMPscript SHA256
description: Returns the SHA-256 hash of the input value. Covers that the bytes hashed are the UTF-8 encoding of the input, and that an unrecognised encoding name aborts the page.

name: AMPscript SHA512
description: Returns the SHA-512 hash of the input value. The bytes hashed are the UTF-8 encoding of the input, and an unrecognised encoding name aborts the page.

name: AMPscript StringToDate
description: Converts a date string to a date value. It produces character-for-character identical output to DateParse for every input, while accepting no second argument at all.

name: AMPscript StringToHex
description: Converts a string to its hexadecimal representation. It renders the UTF-8 bytes of the input in lowercase with no separators, and that the charSet argument accepts four names beyond the two documented.

name: AMPscript Substring
description: Extracts a portion of a string starting at the given index for the specified length. A start position below 1 that clamps silently while a negative length aborts the page.

name: AMPscript Subtract
description: Computes the difference between two numeric values. Covers which argument types are accepted and which abort the page.

name: AMPscript SystemDateToLocalDate
description: Converts a Marketing Cloud system date to the time zone configured on the account. The shift is seasonal rather than a fixed offset.

name: AMPscript TransformXML
description: Transforms an XML document using an XSLT stylesheet. Covers the argument order and the way any bad input takes the whole page down.

name: AMPscript TreatAsContent
description: Evaluates a string as AMPscript content, rendering any embedded AMPscript expressions, and returns the rendered string. Covers that embedded AMPscript is executed rather than escaped.

name: AMPscript TreatAsContentArea
description: Stores a content string under a key for the duration of a send and renders it, evaluating any embedded AMPscript. Covers that it renders the inline second argument rather than looking the key up.

name: AMPscript Trim
description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from a value. Covers that tabs, line breaks and the non-breaking space all count as whitespace.

name: AMPscript UpdateData
description: Updates existing rows in a data extension and returns the number of rows updated. The second argument is the search-pair count.

name: AMPscript UpdateDE
description: Updates existing rows in a data extension and returns an empty string. The email-context twin of UpdateData — the second argument is the search-pair count.

name: AMPscript UpdateSingleSalesforceObject
description: Updates a single record in a connected Salesforce Sales or Service Cloud object via Marketing Cloud Connect and returns 1 on success. Covers that a successful update returns 1 and that a failed update aborts the page instead of returning the documented 0.

name: AMPscript Uppercase
description: Converts a value to upper case. Covers the German sharp s, which is returned untouched instead of expanding to a double S.

name: AMPscript UpsertContact
description: Upserts attributes onto a mobile contact matched by phone number, creating the contact if it does not exist. Create and update return 0 and an unknown attribute returns 1 without writing.

name: AMPscript UpsertData
description: Inserts a row if no match exists, otherwise updates the matching rows, and returns the number of rows affected. The second argument is the search-pair count.

name: AMPscript UpsertDE
description: Inserts a row if no match exists, otherwise updates the matching rows, and returns an empty string. The email-context twin of UpsertData — the second argument is the search-pair count.

name: AMPscript URLEncode
description: URL-encodes a string for safe inclusion in a URL. Leaves a value which is not a URL completely unchanged.

name: AMPscript v
description: Outputs a value inline, normally a variable reference. Covers that a string literal, a number and a nested function call are accepted too, which makes one particular typo render silently instead of failing.

name: AMPscript WrapLongURL
description: Shortens a long URL for email clients that truncate long hyperlinks. Outside a send the argument comes back byte for byte unchanged, whatever its length.
